kjv: nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind
mine: nor men who submit to homosexual acts, nor men who practice them
note: malakoi (soft) and "arsenokoitai" (a rare compound from Lev 18:22/20:13 LXX) refer to the passive and active partners in male intercourse; the KJV's euphemisms obscure the referent, and "effeminate" suggests mannerism rather than acts. The exact sense remains debated.

kjv: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient
mine: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are helpful
note: Paul is quoting a Corinthian slogan and replying to it (also 6:13, 7:1, 8:1); the KJV presents the slogan as Paul's own statement.

kjv: glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's
mine: So glorify God in your body.
note: TR adds "kai en to pneumati hymon, hatina estin tou theou"; absent from P46, Sinaiticus, A, B, C*, D*, F, G. The addition softens Paul's focus on the body.
